pack.name: Starter sound effects pack
pack.note: Two bundled groups, every file CC0 (public domain dedication), usable in any project, commercial or not, with no attribution required. Starter pack: per-file records below were verified at ingestion — each Kenney pack page states 'License: Creative Commons CC0' and each downloaded pack zip contains a License.txt reading 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'; files are the original OGG Vorbis files from the pack zips, renamed only (retrieved 2026-11-10). Meme sounds (added 2026-11-11): ORIGINAL SYNTHESIZED effects made in code by Captionit in the style of the classic meme sounds — never copies of the famous recordings (those are other people's uploads and are not redistributable). CC0-verified real recordings of these classes exist on Freesound, but the Freesound CDN refused downloads from the build sandbox (HTTP 403), so synthesized originals ship instead; each is labelled 'original synthesis' wherever it appears.
